content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist -I (Non - Medical) Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification announces a total of 3 vacancies for project-based positions under the ICMR-funded project titled "Efficacy of Virtual Reality-Based cue Exposure Therapy for Alcohol Dependence: A Single-Site Pilot randomized Controlled Trail."

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Delhi Project Research Scientist -I (Non - Medical) Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: First Class Post Graduate Degree in Public Health / Clinical Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Psychology. Desirable: Those with experience of working in the field of addiction / Psychiatry/Psychology, & experience in conducting psycho-therapy sessions and large Programmes Coordination would be preferred.

Graduate degree in Public Health / Clinical Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Psychology + three years post-qualification experience. OR Post Graduate degree in above field. Desirable: Those with experience of working in the field of addiction/ Psychiatry/ Psychology, experience in conducting Assistive health technologies Psycho-therapy sessions and experience in planning, coordinating, and managing National and State-level training programmes, preferably in the health sector would be preferred.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS Delhi), through the National Drug Dependence Treatment Centre (NDDTC), is conducting this recruitment.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available under advertisement number I-1377-H.

faq.question: Q3. What are the names of the posts offered?
faq.answer: The posts offered are Project Research Scientist -I (Non - Medical) and Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit updated resumes via email is 17 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on 17th October 2026, with relaxation applicable as per Government rules.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the vacancies?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply by sending their updated resumes via email to [email protected] or [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on eligibility, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary for Project Research Scientist -I?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Research Scientist -I (Non - Medical) is ₹56,000 plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The duty station for the selected candidates will be at NDDTC, AIIMS, Ghaziabad (U.P.).
